text:
lucy-sales: Heads up — Northera Labs asking for 35% off on Dedicated for a 6mo pilot, committed 100k/mo spend. Need finance + legal ok before I send contract. cc @ajay @maria

ajay: 35% seems high. What's baseline ACV and why 6mo? can we do 25% + performance milestone for extra?

lucy-sales: Baseline list is ~ $1.2M/yr. Pilot is 6mo to validate scaled model infra; they plan to convert to Dedicated if perf hits. Request is timeboxed pilot discount.

ajay: Ok can we require minimum usage and cap total credits? don't want open-ended refunds.

lucy-sales: Proposed pilot terms:
```
Pilot terms:
- Duration: 6 months
- Committed spend: $600,000 total (100k/mo)
- Discount: 35% off list on Dedicated seats
- Credits cap: $210,000
- Payment: Net30
```

sam-legal: Net30 ok but flag: they asked for Net60 in their PO. Legal prefers Net45 for enterprise. Need IP/data handling clause and KYC. Will add standard indemnity + audit rights.

kevin-cs: Customer insists on Net60 due to procurement cycles. Can we compromise Net45 + early-pay 2%?

maria: Finance view: 35% is pretty deep given the spend profile. Conditional approval if we 1) cap total credits to $180k, 2) change payment to Net45, 3) include auto-convert to standard pricing after pilot. Send me the exact contract language for the cap.

lucy-sales: Can do. I'll update terms to cap at $180k and switch to Net45, include clause to auto-convert to list if they continue. @finance-bot can you create a one-off discount code/ledger entry for tracking?

finance-bot: Ticket created: DISCOUNT-8701. Tracking tags: northera-pilot, 35pct-proposed, cap-180k. Assigned to @maria.

ajay: Also request a rollback clause if usage < 50% of committed in any month — want prorated credit recapture.

sam-legal: Add clause: 'failure to meet monthly commit by >=50% triggers prorated credit recapture and termination of pilot discounts.' I'll draft contractual language and post redline.

maria: Conditional approval recorded. Lucy, update the SOW/quote and route to Legal for signature. Once legal posts final SOW, Finance will finalize ledger entry and recognize as one-off discount.

lucy-sales: Thanks all — updating now. Will post final PDF here when ready. :thumbsup:
